name: brainstorm
description: Brainstorm workflow: topic definition, deep discussion, multi-perspective analysis with 6 parallel specialists, conflict resolution loop, structured results document, and implementation task planning.

steps.name: topic
steps.description: Define brainstorm topic, create branch and task file
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Topic is clearly defined with initial scope.
- [ ] Complete brainstorm task file content composed: frontmatter (task: b-brainstorm-<name>, branch: brainstorm/<name>) plus all required sections.
- [ ] Pass args: {"task": "b-brainstorm-<name>", "branch": "brainstorm/<name>", "task_content": "<full markdown>"} to protocol_advance.

steps.name: discussion
steps.description: Deep discussion recording decisions, also serves as conflict resolution step
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] All open questions and conflicts are resolved.
- [ ] Every decision is recorded in the task file's ## Decisions section with checkboxes.
- [ ] The user confirms readiness to proceed to multi-perspective analysis.
- [ ] If returning from analysis with conflicts: all conflicts resolved and decisions updated.

steps.name: analysis
steps.description: Multi-perspective analysis with 6 parallel specialist subagents
steps.end:
After agents complete:
- [ ] Results documented in the ## Expert Analysis sections — all sections freshly populated.
- [ ] If conflicts exist between experts: document them in ## Conflicts and call protocol_goto(step_name="discussion") instead of advancing.
- [ ] No conflicts remain → advance to results.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Generate results document and get user approval
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Results document written to docs/brainstorm-results/<name>.md with all required sections.
- [ ] 3 task granularity options (minimal/balanced/fine-grained) presented with concrete task lists, and the user chose one.
- [ ] The Implementation Plan section is added to the results document.
- [ ] User has reviewed and approved the complete document — use protocol_goto to go back if changes are needed.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Plan implementation tasks, confirm, then dispatcher runs the provider-driven chain or the 4-option menu flow when issue tracking is disabled.
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Task files are created per the approved Implementation Plan from the results step.
- [ ] Section 2 coverage audit complete — every recorded decision, feature detail, in-scope item, and dead-code entry maps to a created task or an explicit waiver; the ## Task Coverage matrix is written to the results document.
- [ ] User has confirmed both the created tasks and the coverage.
On advance the engine automatically handles completion. When issue_tracking.provider is 'disabled', the user picks a completion_option from the menu presented on step entry — pass args: {"completion_option": "<merge_local|push_pr|keep|discard>"}.
